strings.zh: 空手道服是战斗中的男人的制服！{SCROLL}是前往战斗前线再合适不过的服装了！
strings.en: The karate uniform is the uniform{NEWLINE}of fighters!{SCROLL}There is nothing better suited for{NEWLINE}going to the Battle Frontier than this!

strings.zh: 我这样的小女孩一个人{CLEAR}在战斗前线的话,{CLEAR}大家都会吃惊的,{SCROLL}虽然我并不是去战斗的。
strings.en: Everyone’s surprised to see a little{NEWLINE}girl like me at the Battle Frontier all{CLEAR}by herself,{SCROLL}though I’m not here to battle.
strings.notes: US 0102/1 | RV043: meaning: she is not here to battle (D-1653)

strings.zh: 我从年轻时候开始{NEWLINE}就喜欢精灵对战。{CLEAR}我是这么决定的,{SCROLL}早饭之后来场决斗,{NEWLINE}午饭之后来场决斗,{CLEAR}晚饭之后……{CLEAR}洗个澡睡觉,真爽！
strings.en: I’ve loved Pokémon battles since I was{NEWLINE}young. So I decided on this:{SCROLL}a battle after breakfast, a battle{NEWLINE}after lunch, and after dinner... a bath{CLEAR}and then bed. Feels great!
strings.notes: US 0102/2 | RV043: omission: restored 'I decided' and 真爽

strings.zh: 你好啊冠军大人,{NEWLINE}我是一名超能力者。{CLEAR}我目前正在开发{CLEAR}让人在回忆中战斗的能力。{CLEAR}如果成功的话,{CLEAR}就可以让人在意念中{CLEAR}与曾经对战过的强敌再次战斗了。
strings.en: Hello, Champion. I’m a psychic.{SCROLL}Right now I’m developing{NEWLINE}a power that lets people{CLEAR}battle inside their memories.{SCROLL}If it works, people will be able to{NEWLINE}battle strong opponents they’ve{CLEAR}faced before again, in their minds.

strings.zh: 你好啊冠军大人,{NEWLINE}我是一名超能力者。{CLEAR}只要您放松精神全力配合,{CLEAR}我就可以使用超能力{CLEAR}让您的意识进入到回忆当中。{CLEAR}在回忆中您可以与曾经对战过的强敌{CLEAR}再次进行决斗。{CLEAR}如果您希望与曾经的敌人再次战斗,{CLEAR}我非常乐意为您效劳哦。{SCROLL}要借助魔术师的能力,{NEWLINE}与曾经的敌人对战吗？
strings.en: Hello, Champion. I’m a psychic.{SCROLL}If you relax your mind{NEWLINE}and cooperate fully, I can use{CLEAR}my psychic powers to send your{CLEAR}consciousness into your memories.{SCROLL}There, you can battle the{NEWLINE}strong opponents you’ve{CLEAR}faced before once more.{SCROLL}If you’d like a rematch with a past{NEWLINE}enemy, I’d be delighted to help.{SCROLL}Use the Magician’s power{NEWLINE}to battle a past enemy?
strings.notes: zh calls the psychic 魔术师 (Magician trainer class) in the prompt; kept.

strings.zh: 真不愧是冠军大人,{NEWLINE}无论何时面对强敌都能轻松取胜！
strings.en: That’s the Champion for you!{NEWLINE}No matter when, you beat{CLEAR}strong opponents with ease!
